answer: An agent network auditing jade logistics can deter Sybil attacks using zero-knowledge identity nullifiers. To join, an agent submits a zk-SNARK proving possession of a state-signed e-passport without leaking personal data, publishing only a deterministic credential-epoch hash so peers reject clones that mirror one ID. Creating fake accounts thus requires scarce legal credentials per identity, though resistance hits a nadir if corrupt issuers mint bulk IDs or brokers rent passports.
